review_basis: Direct inspection of all 56 original returned PNG overlay sheets using view_image, with six panels per sheet; no generated substitute images

source_groups.observed: Boxes follow whole-scene reflection, resizing and translation. D00/D10 labels stay unchanged. Boundary repair/crack boxes trigger identity fallback for clipped views. Gray margins appear only with the declared canvas placement.
examples: 01: transverse and longitudinal crack boxes follow the flip without exchanging labels
06 and 08: non-target Repair annotations at boundaries are protected
07: right-edge transverse crack rejects translation/zoom and remains in reflected/shrunk views
source_groups.limitations: Very thin cracks and small potholes are difficult to assess in 320-pixel grayscale tiles.

source_groups.observed: Long boundary-touching cracks, transverse cracks and alligator regions remain aligned in reflected/shrunk views. Center zooms commonly reject because annotations touch the original image edge. Large non-target Repair regions move consistently.
examples: 10: D00 vertical and D10 transverse annotations retain their classes after horizontal reflection
11: multiple D20 regions remain attached to the same cracked painted surface
13: full-width Repair region makes translated/zoomed views fall back
15: adjacent contact-sheet tiles form an apparent V across their boundary, not an artifact inside a transformed image
source_groups.limitations: Box borders partially cover thin crack pixels in the display.

source_groups.observed: Road perspective and camera-view structure remain coherent within each tile. D00, D10, D20 and D40 boxes follow the same scene under reflection, small scale changes and translation. Negative scenes remain without invented annotations.
examples: 17: edge-touching left crack rejects center enlargement
18: transverse crack label remains D10 after scene reflection
20: D40 roadside defect stays inside its relocated box
24: distant small D00 box remains aligned at available preview resolution
source_groups.limitations: Reflected street text/traffic handedness is visible as expected for whole-scene flips; this does not establish augmentation utility. Distant cracks are poorly resolved in these display tiles.

source_groups.observed: Overlapping target boxes move together as one whole-image transformation. Thin transverse regions and roadside defects stay aligned in displayed accepted views. Non-target D60/D43/D44 annotations remain present and move with the scene; cropped proposals fall back.
examples: 25: overlapping D00/D20/D40 boxes maintain their relative positions
28: D40 and non-target D60 remain distinct after reflection
29 and 30: non-target boundary annotations also reject center enlargement
32: existing large D20 annotation remains consistent across allowed views
source_groups.limitations: Low-contrast defects are difficult to interpret at preview resolution. This review checks transformation consistency, not correctness of original semantic labels.

source_groups.observed: Road cracks, potholes and non-target road-feature boxes remain attached to their source pixels. Shadows and background context are reflected with the image rather than moved independently. Boundary-spanning target/non-target annotations correctly cause identity fallbacks.
examples: 34: mixed target and non-target boxes move together, with center zoom and right translation rejected
36: small D40 region remains centered on the visible defect
39: full-width D20 cracking is preserved by rejecting a crop
40: two D40 regions remain aligned in the reflected scene
source_groups.limitations: A visual audit cannot certify the correctness of original class labels or subtle detail retention after resizing.

source_groups.observed: Wide images retain their existing letterbox bands; added shifts/scaling change band placement as specified. Small and multiple crack boxes follow the scene under reflection. Negative scenes remain unannotated and geometrically coherent.
examples: 41: edge D00/D40 boxes are protected by center-zoom rejection
42: thin transverse and longitudinal boxes track their original road positions
44: multiple small annotations move consistently, though labels obscure much of the tiny damage
45,47,48: no-target scenes retained without invented labels
source_groups.limitations: Wide-view compression makes some boxes and cracks too small for fine-detail assessment. Gray padding is expected and not evidence of lost source pixels.

source_groups.observed: Longitudinal/transverse/alligator/pothole labels and boxes follow road features through whole-image flips and modest scale/translation. Zoom rejects edge-touching annotations. Shadows, markings and surrounding context move consistently.
examples: 49 and 50: transverse cracks keep their D10 labels under reflection
51: both D20 boxes remain on the same cracked road areas
52: mixed D00/D20/D40 boxes preserve relative placement
54 and 56: bottom-edge crack boxes trigger correct identity fallback on zoom
source_groups.limitations: Street text and watermarks reflect as expected; tiny or shaded damage cannot be certified at grayscale preview resolution.

limits: No independent native-resolution inspection of every raw RGB variant; only saved representative grayscale contact sheets were available
No label-semantic reannotation or guarantee of thin-crack visibility
Not evidence of improved detector AP or controller stability
decision: Proceed to a bounded frozen-detector controller check; full training remains premature
